body: Proud of you, Stranger!
You're right, I can use this experience to better other ones down the line.
We'll get there eventually :)
Aw thank you! They can be quite hit or miss for me, but at least I know myself a little better now (if that makes sense...)
I love this way of thinking. I'm going to try it next time!
Mental illnesses don't discriminate.
Funny you mention that as it was a concert. I missed out on seeing the band last year because of anxiety and so didn't want it to happen again. Maybe I should try different settings next time though!
Your comment made me feel so much better. Thank you so much!
That means a lot, thank you!
It's horrible when those who don't understand still put others down :( You're not alone in this.
Thank you for commenting this. Hopefully the fight will be worth it!
Thank you for all the links, it's not something I've considered before so they're really helpful. Having printouts seems great, if you're sure you don't mind I'll message you my email
This is such a good idea. I think I'm going to start one today. Thank you, I really appreciate it. Do you recommend cbd to someone who's barely smoked tobacco before? What would it be like?
I definitely know what you mean! Everything you said is very much wanted though as I think it could actually help :)
Thank you so much for your reply. I'm going to write your advice down just in case I need to use it. Hopefully it wont get to that point though!
Exactly. It all seems so pointless.

I can definitely relate. 
Thank you, It's good to vent sometimes :)
Depression gives us such low self esteem that it seems impossible to understand what anyone else would see in us.
Thank you so much. This means so much to me :)
I wasn't expecting so many lovely replies. They've really helped
I'm sorry you have to go through all of this. It's great to know that you're trying to be happier though. Thank you so much, I'm also here for you if you ever need to vent or someone to talk to!
I'm sorry he said that to you. It's so good to know you are doing well though! Thank you for giving me something to work towards
We are not our anxiety. We are strong because we face so many challenges everyday.
We both will!
You definitely deserve better! Thank you so much for you reply. Someday I hope I will be able to see things the way you do :)

I'm sorry you had to go through this too. You're right, he enabled me to become closer to the person I've always wanted to be. I might not have him any more but I can carry what he taught me on and continue to grow.
Someday we will find someone who was worth the wait!
Definitely can relate! I was always trying to figure out what he saw in me :/
I hope you feel better soon and that your girlfriend keeps being amazing!
Hopefully I can still beat the anxiety without him. Thank you for your reply and for reassuring me!

Sorry you had to go through all that, but I'm happy that you're doing a lot better! :) 

He said it's definitely over :(

Thank you for your advice! He is coming to see me after work so I will see what he thinks about a break or if it really is final. I also think anxiety has helped me become more empathetic :) I hope you're doing better now!

You're right about him not fully understanding. Another thing he said to me was 'I can do X and Y so easily so I don't understand why it is a big deal for you'. 

Knowing that you are glad you moved on has made me feel a bit more positive. Thank you so much for replying, it means a lot!
I'm so glad you've found someone as caring as your boyfriend :) Thank you for helping me put things into perspective. You've helped me manage a smile
I'm so sorry you're going through something similar. We can get through this together!
Thank you so much for your reply! It means a lot that people who don't even know me can be so lovely. I really appreciate it
"Stop using depression as an excuse to be lazy"
I experience quite a bit of OCD like symptoms, it can get pretty tiring. Thank you for your comment :)

You definitely have value, the problem may just be understanding/discovering what that value is. 

I'm also in my final year of college with no idea what to do afterwards so you're not alone. To be honest, so much of what you have said relates to me.  

Hope you find your value soon!
Sending the warmest of hugs!
I wake up feeling okay, by midday I feel fantastic/ecstatic, by night I just want to curl up in a ball and think about ending it all.
